subject: prd/implement-now
statement: For a direct issue proposal, the host shall publish a schema-versioned execution summary correlated to the admitted contract, attempts, and exact proposal revision, containing observed harness/model/effort by execution role, available token totals, attempt counts, and command-start-to-terminal elapsed time with that boundary stated. Every unavailable counter, including tool counts and intake-session usage when unobservable, shall be explicitly unavailable; unknown shall never be rendered as zero.
rationale: the host can report a useful baseline without reconstructing harness transcripts or inventing full end-to-end attribution
fit_criterion: GitHub and Forgejo summaries round-trip closed typed JSON and readable text; observed and unavailable counter fixtures remain distinct; launch choices match captured execution rather than declared preferences; elapsed-time boundary is explicit
